relations.subject: Alf Sommerfelt
relations.evidence: Alf Sommerfelt (November 23, 1892 – October 12, 1965) was a Norwegian linguist and the first professor of linguistics in Norway, working at the University of Oslo from 1931 to 1962.

relations.subject: Alf Sommerfelt
relations.evidence: Together with the Slavicist Olaf Broch, Sommerfelt founded the Norwegian association for linguistics in 1924
